textos.texto: Good morning! My name is Ana. Nice to meet you. Hi, Ana! My name is Paul. Nice to meet you too. How are you, Paul? I am fine, thank you. And you? Very well, thanks! Excuse me, is Mr Lee here? Yes, Mr Lee is here. Good afternoon, Mr Lee! Good afternoon, Ana. Welcome! Thank you very much. You're welcome. And Mrs Lee? Sorry, no. Mrs Lee is not here. No problem! Miss Sofia is here. Good afternoon, Miss Sofia. See you later, Ana. Bye, Paul! Have a nice day! See you tomorrow, Ana. Take care!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Cómo se llama la mujer que se presenta primero?
Mr Lee es el profesor de Ana.
¿Qué le desea Paul a Ana al despedirse?
Ana y Paul se conocen por primera vez.

textos.texto: Good evening! Hello, my name is Laura. Hey, Laura! I am Marc. Nice to meet you. Sorry, what is your name, please? My name is Marc. No problem! How are you, Marc? Fine, thanks. And you? Very well! Welcome, Marc. Thank you very much. You're welcome. Excuse me, is Miss Ana here? Yes! Hello, Ana! Hello, Laura! Good evening, Marc. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too. Have a nice evening! Thank you, Ana. See you soon! Goodbye, Laura. Good night! Good night, Marc. Take care! Bye!

preguntas.enunciado: Laura y Marc ya se conocían de antes.
¿Con qué palabra muy informal saluda Marc a Laura?
La fiesta es en la casa de Ana.
¿Quién pide que le repitan el nombre?
¿Qué le desea Ana a Marc para la noche?
